name: BetterFingers
summary: A private desktop speech editor that transcribes speech, refines it with local models, and lets users review and place text into other applications.

features.title: Local speech capture and transcription
features.summary: Captures speech from a desktop trigger and transcribes it with a local Whisper-based runtime.

features.title: Local persona refinement
features.summary: Refines transcribed text with local LLM personas, formatting commands, a personal dictionary, and text macros.

features.title: Review and text placement
features.summary: Provides an editable review step before placing text into the focused application and restores the clipboard afterward.

features.title: Recovery and privacy controls
features.summary: Retains raw recordings for recovery and provides local privacy reporting and data-wipe controls.

features.title: Hardware-aware model selection
features.summary: Reports hardware capabilities and recommends local model tiers that fit the machine's available resources.

features.title: Hands-free wake word
features.summary: A hands-free wake-word path remains planned release work and is not represented as shipped here.

roadmap.title: Public release qualification
roadmap.summary: Complete release signing and reproducibility work, core-loop reliability evidence, and an injection compatibility matrix before a tagged public release.

roadmap.title: Unified data lifecycle
roadmap.summary: Unify retention and deletion handling across the local data stores as tracked in the repository roadmap.

roadmap.title: macOS support
roadmap.summary: Add and qualify a macOS build; macOS is not supported by the current project evidence.
